rationale: Existing stable plans and backup formats already support the retained representations. This maintenance moves their proven lossless conversions to one recoverable server boundary, adds source inventory/lifetime evidence, and preserves older backend readers and non-equivalent forms without a new user control.

summary.ru: Старые формы планов безопасно преобразуются на сервере один раз; исходную копию можно получить для совместимого отката.
summary.en: Old plan forms upgrade safely once at the server boundary, with their original snapshot available for compatible rollback.
